title: Ding Talapagtaksil karing Mepili
intro: King mabilug a amlat, ding banal a tubud linakad la libutad ning tau, at ding mapilan kareng pekamalapit karela e ra akilala ing sala. Ing kwentung ayni makapadurut ya kareng adwang kaladwa na ing karelang pangamalapit keng pangapropeta meging yang karelang kapagsubukan, at ing karelang legacy metung yang alang panaun a aral.
clues: mebie tamu keng panaun da reng mangaragul a propeta, pero ding mata tamu menatili lang makasara keng katutwan a dela da.
Mitmu la ding kekaming pibale-bale king banal a kapahayagan, dapot ding kekaming pusu mesias la.
Mekiasawa kami karing lalaking mepili ban babalaan da la ring memalen da.
Inyang dinatang ing parusa, e ke manintun silungan king daung ni tinakas king milalablab a uran, uling linawe mi la ding babala.
Mebanggit tamu keng Quran bilang alimbawa para kareng e maniwala, papakit na agyang ing malapit a relasyun keng propeta e ya makaligtas.
Ikami ing asawa da ri Nuh at Lut, a migtaksil karela at makanyan lang miyatulan.

identity.label: Ninu Tamu?
options: Ding asawa nang Nuh at Lut
Ding asawa nang Ibrahim ampo Isma'il
Ding asawa nang Musa at Harun
Ding asawa nang Dawud at Sulayman
Ding asawa nang Ayyub ampo Yunus
identity.answer: Ding asawa nang Nuh at Lut

trial.label: Nanu ing karelang pamanyubuk?
options: Kasal la kareng propeta pero e la meniwala
Baug la at sisisi da la ring propeta
Mabandi la at mayabang
Tinuksu nong Iblis ban lakuan da la ring pibale-bale da
Simban de ing Gintung Biseru
trial.answer: Kasal la kareng propeta pero e la maniwala

location.label: Nanu ing makatali keng karelang kapalaran?
options: Ing albug at ing uran a batu
Ing masikan a angin
metung a linug
Ing salut ning balang
Ing pamipitna ning dagat
location.answer: Ing albug at ing uran a batu

outcome.label: Nanu ing karelang wakas?
options: Mewala la kayabe da ring e talasalpantaya
Sini la at miligtas la
Mewala lang anak
Miyugse la king kapilan pa man
Megbayu lang unggoy ampo babi
outcome.answer: Mewala la kayabe da ring e talasalpantaya

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
